name: Metropolis Healthcare Ltd
title: Metropolis Healthcare Ltd - 542650 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Diagnostics chain guides 14-15% revenue CAGR and 27-28% EBITDA over 3 years; FY26 organic margin 25.9% (+140bps) with capex now throughput-led, not expansion-led.

utilisation.quote: the productivity of the existing network improved with the same lab growth at about 14%

capex.quote: That heavy build -out phase is now largely behind us, and the focus has clearly shifted from expanded capex to throughput -led productivity.

triggers.label: Capex shifts to throughput; FY26 capex INR 65 cr
triggers.quote: the focus has clearly shifted from expanded capex to throughput -led productivity

triggers.label: Lab productivity +14%; lab additions over
triggers.quote: In the coming year also, we are not planning to add a high number of labs in the network

triggers.label: No price hike in Q4; realisation ~5%
triggers.quote: unlike last year, we did not take a price increase in quarter 4 due to GST reasons

triggers.label: Next-year margin +125-150bps
triggers.quote: we'll definitely be looking at about 125 to 150 bps improvement in the coming year

guidance.quote: the vision is to grow at a CAGR of 14% to 15% in revenue
achieving a sustainable group EBITDA margin of 27% to 28% over the next 3 years
we'll definitely be looking at about 125 to 150 bps improvement in the coming year
over a 3-year horizon, we want to take this to 35:1 lab-to-center ratio
about 8% to 9% of patient volume growth is what we are estimating for the coming fiscal

prior_guidance_check.quote: We delivered organic revenue growth of 13.7%, better than our stated guidance of 12% to 13%.

prior_guidance_check.metric: Core Diagnostics EBITDA to high-single-digit in Q4
prior_guidance_check.quote: we would move from a negative 2% EBITDA to a high -single-digit EBITDA in Q4. We have completed this mission.

evasions.topic: Organic vs inorganic EBITDA split and intersegment eliminations
evasions.quote: Honestly, we can go and split the heads, but the reality is now the acquisition is a year old.
It's very difficult for us to give one unit as lab utilization per se in this business.
